# MSNS-LMS — Comprehensive System & Architecture Knowledge Base

## 1. System Overview
MSNS-LMS is the dedicated web and mobile Learning Management System engineered specifically for M. S. Naz High School® (MSNS), located in Ghakhar Mandi and serving Wazirabad and the Gujranwala district in Punjab, Pakistan. It replaces paper-based administration with an automated, role-based cloud platform connecting school leadership, teachers, administrative clerks, students, and parents.

- **Application Name**: MSNS-LMS (M. S. Naz High School ERP & LMS)
- **Primary Domain**: https://lms.msns.edu.pk
- **Authentication Route**: https://lms.msns.edu.pk/sign-in
- **Parent Institution**: M. S. Naz High School® (https://www.msns.edu.pk)
- **Campus Headquarters**: G.T. Road, Opposite Model Police Station, Ghakhar Mandi, Punjab, Pakistan (Postal Code: 52200)
- **Contact / Support**: info@msns.edu.pk | +92-301-6233609

---

## 2. Core Modules & Functionality

### 2.1 Academic Administration
- Academic session management (yearly sessions, class terms, sections, and subject mapping).
- Student enrollment lifecycle: admission tracking, roll number allocation, class promotion, and alumni records.
- Faculty subject allocations and timetable tracking.

### 2.2 Attendance Management
- Real-time morning attendance tracking across all grades.
- Automated instant alerts sent to parents regarding student arrivals, absences, and departures.
- Monthly attendance percentages computed for board exam eligibility (BISE Gujranwala criteria).

### 2.3 Homework, Assignments & Digital Diary
- Daily digital diary entries populated by subject instructors.
- Assignment submission tracking for high school science, AI, and computer science courses.
- Reduction of paper diaries and missed assignments.

### 2.4 Examination, Grading & Report Cards
- Support for monthly tests, mid-term examinations, and annual final assessments.
- Standardized grading scales aligned with BISE Gujranwala matriculation requirements.
- Dynamic automated PDF report card generation for parents.

### 2.5 Finance, Fee Vouchers & Accounting
- Configurable fee categories (tuition, laboratory, transport, examinations).
- Automatic generation of monthly and quarterly fee challan vouchers.
- Clerk reconciliation workflow for fee receipts, scholarship concessions, and sibling discounts.
- Comprehensive institutional expense tracking (utilities, salaries, lab supplies) and financial statements.

---

## 3. Technology Stack & Security
- **Frontend / Framework**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend Architecture**: tRPC type-safe API, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL database.
- **Mobile Integration**: Capacitor-based Android native app packaging and Progressive Web App (PWA) with service worker offline support.
- **Data Security**: Role-based access control (RBAC), encrypted sessions, and isolated tenant records.
